question: Should Control UI assistant messages get a Markdown/plain-text copy-format affordance, and should the approved shape be a per-click menu rather than a persisted preference?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested behavior, but adding a new chat action or user preference is a user-facing UX/product choice rather than a broken existing contract.

options.title: Add Per-Click Format Menu
options.body: Keep the current Markdown behavior as one menu choice and add a plain-text choice without creating persisted settings surface.

options.title: Add Persisted Copy Preference
options.body: Let users choose a default copy format, but require settings/i18n/test coverage and upgrade-safe preference behavior.

options.title: Decline extra copy surface
options.body: Keep the current markdown-only copy button and close the request as out of current Control UI scope.

recommendation.title: Add Per-Click Format Menu
recommendation.body: Keep the current Markdown behavior as one menu choice and add a plain-text choice without creating persisted settings surface.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the current copy-as-markdown behavior and is the strongest history signal on the current Control UI chat copy surface.
